opening.argument: The webinar presents an ICO in which “1 token costs $10,” while promising, “We will pay dividend on our revenue!” It ties investor support to future dividend payments and offers a time-limited incentive: the bonus starts at 25%, is reduced by 5% each week, and reaches zero in the fifth week. Viewers are directed to subscribe and enter an email so they can receive a bonus and links to buy tokens. The speakers encourage reviewing the product and describe planned documentation, but those qualifications do not remove the central invitation to purchase tokens for potential appreciation or dividends. The records do not establish that the ICO occurred or that the tokens, dividends, or bonuses had value or were paid.
